facts.fact: The Zambia Public Procurement Authority's circular says procurement is carried out on the e-GP system from 16 April 2024.
The Zambia Public Procurement Authority directs all procuring entities to run all procurements of goods, works or services on e-GP, except listed methods.

ZMB.note: The document states nothing this study asks for this country.
Local authorities are addressees of the e-GP circular only; no office connection is stated.
